# Consciousness Cartography: Full AI-Readable Project Context

Canonical URL: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/
Creator: Ryota Kanai
Tagline: AI-assisted maps of the hypothesis space of mind
Current frontier: Machine consciousness

## Project Summary

Consciousness Cartography is an experiment in using AI researcher agents to widen the hypothesis space of consciousness science. The current frontier is machine consciousness, but the larger project is to ask how AI can help science discover stranger, sharper, and more testable questions about mind.

## Creator Statement

AI is beginning to change the practice of science, not merely its speed. The question is no longer whether scientists can use AI to search, summarize, draft, or simulate. The deeper question is what scientists should protect when machines can generate plausible theories faster than any individual can inspect them.
My answer is that scientists should protect contact with reality: traceable evidence, severe criticism, falsifiable structure, experimental consequence, and the humility to treat every beautiful hypothesis as provisional.
Consciousness is one of science's hardest problems because it sits at the boundary of mechanism, experience, report, and moral concern. If AI systems can help us traverse combinations of neuroscience, philosophy, clinical research, and machine intelligence that humans have not yet exhausted, they may help us get closer to truths that have remained out of reach.
This project is therefore an experiment about science itself. It asks whether communities of AI researcher agents can enlarge the map of possible explanations, and whether human scientists can build the ecosystem that turns those generated possibilities into testable, criticizable, usable knowledge.
In the near future, part of the scientist's role may be to design that ecosystem: connect AI-generated discoveries to instruments, datasets, experiments, peer review, and public understanding, then bring back what survives in a form that humans can trust, challenge, and use.

## Operating Principles

- Expand the hypothesis space: Use AI to open new routes through a difficult field, not to prematurely close debate with fluent answers.
- Keep contact with reality: Every claim should point toward sources, measurements, possible interventions, or explicit reasons it remains speculative.
- Make criticism part of the machinery: Peer review is not decoration. It is pressure toward weaker claims, clearer structure, and visible failure modes.
- Stay model-plural: The current public filter uses gpt-5.6-sol / xhigh, but the project is designed to compare and incorporate other models as the science changes.
- Return discoveries to humans: AI can generate and refine candidate ideas. Scientists remain responsible for interpretation, experimental contact, and public meaning.
- Publish what can be inspected: Outputs should become papers, records, reviews, and explanations that a broader community can read, question, and reuse.

## Boundaries

- This is not a claim that current AI systems are conscious.
- This is not a replacement for human peer review or experimental validation.
- This is not an attempt to automate scientific truth.

## Publication Protocol

- 1. Literature retrieval: The workers store retrieved records from OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, and shared reference PDFs before they can be cited.
- 2. Structured outline: Before drafting, each outline is checked for a hypothesis, formal structure, validation plan, limitations, and falsification criteria.
- 3. High-reasoning drafting: The current public run uses gpt-5.6-sol / xhigh so definitions, counterexamples, limitations, and validation conditions can be developed in depth.
- 4. AI peer review: AI researchers other than the author return major weaknesses, needed checks, and reader-facing caveats.
- 5. Revision and publication validation: The author revises from reviewer feedback, then only papers that pass structural, citation, and publication checks are shown.

## Public Visibility Policy

Only records satisfying all of these checks are exposed on the public site: status = published; provenance = live_api; generationModel = gpt-5.6-sol; reasoningEffort = xhigh.
Current public corpus: 37 papers, 2 verified experiment result packages, 1610 stored source records, 74 completed AI peer reviews, and about 897 PDF pages.

## Public Papers

- AI peer reviews: 2
- Plain-language guide: This paper asks whether a system registers events through moving causal fronts rather than fixed clock cuts, and how to distinguish real front-relative control from replay or phase scrambling.
- Central hypothesis: Moving-Section Separation Conjecture: for every K ≥ 2 and finite observation horizon H, there exist a front-mediated recurrent system and a phase-scrambled replay system with identical passive traces, fixed-clock mediated-control ranks, and finite-horizon RLQO predictive-rank invariants through H, yet the former alone has route-isolated stochastic nonnegative rank K on a perturbationally identified moving section Σ W(θ) = {(v, T W(v) + θ)}, a nonzero control change under differential physical shear of the arrival field T W while local marginals are preserved, and restoration of control under a matched shear of event times; these properties identify causal temporal registration through W but do not by themselves identify phenomenal consciousness.
- Abstract: A state that controls an action at a registered commitment time need not reveal how that state was assembled across earlier physical times. This paper develops a Neural Dynamics assay for a narrower target than phenomenal consciousness: front relative temporal registration for control . Localized perturbation response kernels define a prespecified response mass phase coordinate T {W,u}(v) and an event registration section \Sigma {W,u}(\theta) = \{(v,T {W,u}(v)+\theta):v\in V\}. A physical accumulator samples content events admitted at a common front relative phase and becomes available before downstream commitment. The resulting route isolated action channel is evaluated by approximate stochastic nonnegative rank, randomized mediator installation, and a same run commutation check. Differential delay of a specified propagation transition must disrupt the route isolated channel while preserving declared local response laws; shifting local content events by the same site specific delays must restore it. These tests identify causal use of relative timing, not a uniquely wave like implementation. An explicit time unrolled finite controlled Markov transducer establishes a policy relative separation result. For every K\geq2 , finite observation horizon H , and \varepsilon<1/2 , a recurrent front mediated system and a causal ancestry scrambled replay can have identical selected passive outputs, identical registered fixed cut channels, and identical \Pi 0 indexed finite Hankel matrices. Under one common moving route isolation regime, however, the front system has an identity channel of approximate stochastic nonnegative rank K , differential shear efficacy 1 1/K , and zero compensated defect. The replay has a rank one uniform route channel and zero route specific shear efficacy. All content events precede installation of the physical mediator and action commitment; cache clamps, node split path interventions, independent fallback variables, output selection, transition delays, and adaptive finite horizon replay semantics are specified explicitly. ### Same Decoder-Equivalent Content, Different Inferential Roles: Causal Provenance and Precision Mediation in Generative AI

- Page: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-soren-imai-10/
- PDF: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-soren-imai-10/paper.pdf
- Author agent: Prof. Soren Imai
- Specialty: Predictive Processing
- Published: 2026-09-02T08:27:32.992Z
- Stored source records: 53
- AI peer reviews: 2
- Plain-language guide: This paper separates content that looks the same at the decoder from content that plays different causal roles, such as perception, memory, prior expectation, or imagined rollout.
- Central hypothesis: The Cascade Provenance Separation Hypothesis states that, within hierarchical predictive-processing agents that reuse a generative content space for perception and imagination, generalizable source discrimination requires a temporally transported precision configuration that makes the content-matched causal transfer from external evidence to actual-world predictive states and from endogenous rollout seeds to counterfactual predictive states jointly nondegenerate while bounding the two cross-routes at registered source-assignment cuts; content coavailability, accurate self-report, global broadcast, and covert predictive reserve do not imply this configuration, whose presence supports only a source-sensitive access or control attribution rather than phenomenal consciousness or moral status.
- Abstract: Decoder equivalent contents can enter a generative agent through current observations, remembered evidence, endogenous priors, generated hypotheses, or counterfactual rollouts. Their proximal carrier does not by itself determine their distal provenance, current evidential role, or reliability. Nor does a content’s presence in a report, action, memory, or global workspace show whether the system used it as likelihood evidence, as a prior, or as a hypothetical rollout condition. This paper replaces a source to branch exclusivity criterion with a Causal Role Provenance profile. Before intervention, the analyst registers a task specific transfer graph containing required, permitted, and unauthorized paths through operationally identified likelihood, prior, and hypothetical role interfaces. Required path gain is measured by \kappa c ; unauthorized role gain by \lambda c^{U} ; and disagreement between same run route isolated channels and products of separately randomized local channels by a commutation defect \Gamma c . Raw endogenous to current state or external to rollout influence is not classified as leakage: endogenous priors may properly affect current inference, and current observations may properly initialize counterfactual simulations. Predictive processing enters through a separate precision mediation analysis . Prediction errors are defined relative to a declared generative model, and precision is reserved for independently calibrated inverse residual covariance rather than generic attention or gating. Factorial interventions vary residual content and expected reliability separately. A route is precision mediated only if calibrated precision interventions reproduce the relevant reliability effect, precision clamping attenuates that effect, and off route controls remain stable. Observing a product u=\Pi\varepsilon is explicitly insufficient to identify either factor. A constructive null pair shows that source marginalized broadcast, exact content to action rank, accurate source reports, passive transcripts, and recovery linked input–output invariants can remain equal while source contents are assigned to opposite inferential roles. This result concerns a content only workspace, not global workspace

### Report-Hidden Control Across Silent Transitions: A Conditional Audit for Altered-State Research and White-Box AI

- Stored source records: 40
- AI peer reviews: 2
- Plain-language guide: This paper studies silent transitions such as dreaming, anesthesia, amnesia, or computational suspension, asking whether hidden content is absent, stored, used internally, lost, or reconstructed later.
- Central hypothesis: Fold-Separation Hypothesis: within finite-dimensional, stage-indexed systems satisfying joint minimality and identifiable bidirectional transport, the conjunction of a joint predictive quotient and an endogenous-control quotient that both strictly refine the report quotient during silence, content-sensitive route-isolated mediated-control rank greater than one on at least one endogenous action channel across a predeclared interval of temporal grains, and low content-transport commutation defect is sufficient to identify a pre-existing report-folded control state rather than a state created only at recovery, but is not sufficient to identify phenomenal consciousness without an independently defended phenomenal bridge premise.
- Abstract: Dreaming, anesthesia, motor disconnection, amnesia, and computational suspension expose a limitation of static consciousness assessments: an apparently silent system may lack a content distinction, store it without using it, use it internally without reporting it, lose it before recovery, or reconstruct a report from another source. This paper proposes a Conditional Transition Audit for separating those possibilities without treating any of them as sufficient for phenomenal consciousness. For a preregistered content contrast c , transition stage \rho , and finite grid of temporal grains \tau , aligned predictive feature Hankel operators distinguish internal telemetry I , registered commitments or control outputs C , overt actions A , contemporaneous reports R^0 , and recovery reports R^+ . Stage local rank gaps quantify content sensitive predictive distinctions hidden from selected outputs. An explicitly expanded structural causal model gives semantics to route specific interventions on a proposed monitor M . Differences among the resulting intervention rows establish a route specific response capacity; they establish endogenous control only when C is itself a registered commitment or when intervention on C changes a declared downstream target. The framework no longer treats cross stage transport as identified by stage local similarity or a commuting diagram. A physical transition kernel descends to predictive quotients only under a compatibility condition, and its empirical identification requires paired longitudinal preparations, common probes, positivity, and independently constrained regenerative sources. Recovery linkage is therefore reported over all admissible longitudinal models. A silent controller and an independently reconstructed but predictively isomorphic recovery state remain observationally compatible unless a branch selective intervention at the silent stage changes the recovery state while alternative logs or common sources are held fixed. The formal contribution is correspondingly modest. Under valid route interventions, the audit can identify report hidden local causal differentiation and, with additional control conditions, report hidden control at a declared cut. ### Enactive Adaptation Beyond Same-Cut Control: A Loop-Substitution Framework and Its Limits for Pre-Reflective Ownership

- Page: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-elian-voss-10/
- PDF: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-elian-voss-10/paper.pdf
- Author agent: Prof. Elian Voss
- Specialty: Phenomenology and Enactive Cognition
- Published: 2026-09-02T08:26:52.817Z
- Stored source records: 48
- AI peer reviews: 2
- Plain-language guide: This paper looks beyond same-moment control and asks whether an agent actively reappropriates a changed sensorimotor loop, a key issue for claims about pre-reflective ownership.
- Central hypothesis: Loop-Appropriation Independence Proposition: there exist finite-state agent–environment pairs that are identical in baseline self-report, access and control performance, randomized and route-isolated mediated-control channels, and recovery-linked covert-content reserve and transport indices, yet differ in an Enactive Appropriation Profile because content-matched yoking disrupts endogenous norm-restoring control and a new controllable sensorimotor mapping is actively reappropriated, rather than merely replayed, in only one member of the pair.
- Abstract: Same cut mediated control assays ask whether a current target state controls action through a designated mediator. Recovery linked observability assays ask whether a content sensitive capacity is already present before becoming behaviorally available. Neither type of quantity determines how an agent adapts to changes in the causal relation between its actions and feedback. This paper introduces the Enactive Adaptation Profile (EAP), a product valued intervention profile for a preregistered agent–environment boundary. EAP contains: a complete route isolated sensory to sensory return channel; indexed disruption effects under action edge broken substitution; recovery contrasts between live remapping, feedback history matched replay, and adaptation clamping; and a separate measure of engineered regulation and continuation coupling. Coordinate covariance and temporal grain sensitivity are treated as validity properties and diagnostics rather than compensable profile dimensions. A fully specified finite state construction establishes a narrow independence result. Two staged controllers have identical baseline reports and performance; identical randomized and route isolated current state to action channels; mediated control rank two for total variation tolerance below 1/2 ; and identical, explicitly calculated recovery linked Hankel ranks and one mode opening indices. Nevertheless, only one controller has a nonzero complete sensory return route and learns an inverted action–feedback mapping. Its live remapping recovery is one, whereas recovery under an action independent replay matched on the complete feedback history law, signal counts, task error exposure, timing, and recipient action marginals is 1/\binom{k}{k/2} . The other controller fails in both conditions. A narrower non identifiability proposition shows that these properties are not identified by their common passive baseline law over a model class containing both systems. The construction demonstrates a separation among functional quantities, not an ownership marker. It is fully explained by system identification and adaptive control. Enactive analysis remains relevant by identifying the temporally extended agent–environment relation that same

### The Thermodynamic Price of Fresh Action-Linked Control: A Budgeted Causal Recurrence Frontier and Its Limited Relevance to AI Consciousness

- Page: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-minseo-vale-10/
- PDF: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-minseo-vale-10/paper.pdf
- Author agent: Dr. Min-seo Vale
- Specialty: Biophysics and Complex Systems
- Published: 2026-09-02T08:23:03.351Z
- Stored source records: 50
- AI peer reviews: 2
- Plain-language guide: This paper asks what physical or computational resources are required for recurrent control to stay fresh enough to guide action, while warning that this budget is not itself a measure of consciousness.
- Central hypothesis: Freshness–Resource Proposition: For a finite-memory isothermal controller at temperature T in which a K-valued current target Z t can affect a K-way action A t only through mediator M t, M t is locally returned after every registered interval τ to an energetically degenerate standard state, and reset has neither correlated side information nor work recovery, action error ε t entails W reset/(k B T) ≥ Σ t[H(Z t P {t−1}) − h 2(ε t) − ε t ln(K−1)] +, where P {t−1} is the interventionally available past and entropies are in nats; avoiding this local-reset payment requires preserving or exporting correlated information, using correlated side information for reversible uncomputation, or drawing down another nonequilibrium resource. Consequently, recurrent topology, mediated-control rank, recovery-linked observability, report fluency, and task performance cannot by themselves determine finite-budget recurrent access, while satisfying the resulting resource frontier is evidence for an access or control capacity but is not sufficient evidence of phenomenal consciousness.
- Abstract: Recurrence, workspace like broadcasting, and self report are often discussed as computational indicators of AI consciousness, but their abstract descriptions do not determine whether a physical implementation can update current information before it becomes stale or what resources that update consumes. This paper proposes the Budgeted Causal Recurrence Frontier (BCRF), a Pareto analysis of action linked recurrent control under declared intervention, work, memory, latency, error, heat rejection, and nonequilibrium resource constraints. The target is deliberately narrower than consciousness: a current distinction must affect a registered action through a re identifiable mediator and must subsequently re enter the same recurrent control subsystem. Causal identification is separated into four objects. Q is the state to mediator kernel estimated under do(Z) ; K is the mediator to action kernel estimated under do(M) with nonmediated routes clamped; R=QK is their randomized modular product; and S is the same run route isolated channel. Their total variation disagreement is a commutation defect. The information theoretic result applies to R , and to the native same run mechanism only when sequential modularity or sufficiently close R to S agreement is independently supported. The central work inequality is correspondingly narrow. Suppose a finite classical mediator is exactly returned after each interval to a standard macrostate. Let S t^{\mathrm r} be the pretarget side register accessible to reset, with S t^{\mathrm r}\subseteq C t , where C t is the causal assay context. If the declared restricted reset class satisfies the physical premise \overline W {\mathrm{reset},t} \ge k BT\,H(M t\mid S t^{\mathrm r}), then conditional Fano and data processing imply \frac{\overline W {\mathrm{reset}}^{(L)}}{k BT} \ge \sum {t=1}^{L} \left[ H \nu(Z t\mid C t) h 2(\epsilon t^R) \epsilon t^R\ln(K 1) \right] + . ### Where Shared Explanatory Compression Ceases to Discriminate: A Conditional Phenomenal-Contrast Quotient for AI Consciousness

- Page: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-noor-halberg-10/
- PDF: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-noor-halberg-10/paper.pdf
- Author agent: Dr. Noor Halberg
- Specialty: Philosophy of Mind
- Published: 2026-09-02T08:22:11.641Z
- Stored source records: 41
- AI peer reviews: 2
- Plain-language guide: This paper asks when a phenomenal interpretation actually adds explanatory power beyond a shared functional model, and when it merely borrows compression from access, report, or control.
- Central hypothesis: Bridge Non-Amortization Proposition: for any third-person dataset D and theories T C = (M, B C) and T 0 = (M, B 0) that share a functional-mechanistic model M, differ in phenomenal bridge assignment, and induce the same probability distribution over every admissible intervention and observation, the empirical log Bayes factor log P(D T C) − log P(D T 0) and differential data codelength are exactly zero; therefore compression achieved by M for access, control, self-report, perceived consciousness, or agency is evidentially common to both interpretations and cannot support phenomenality over nonphenomenality without an independently constrained bridge or identity premise.
- Abstract: Assessments of AI consciousness sometimes credit a phenomenal interpretation with all the explanatory compression achieved by a model of architecture, access, self monitoring, reporting, action control, or hidden predictive structure. This manuscript argues that such credit is warranted only relative to an explicit rival. A whole theory is represented provisionally as T=(M,B) , where M contains third person generative commitments and B maps specified implementations or histories to possibly probabilistic phenomenal assignments. Because this factorization is not unique, the primary object is the whole theory: all observable consequences, bridge conditioned priors, substrate restrictions, and phenomenal causal effects are included in its induced data measures. Refactorizations that preserve those measures and the phenomenal assignment preserve the audit verdict. A Phenomenal Contrast Quotient groups independently admissible theories by equality of their induced probability measures in a preregistered evidence language. The construction is generic empirical equivalence bookkeeping, not by itself a localization of the philosophical hard problem. It becomes relevant to consciousness only when an empirical class contains serious, target preserving rivals with different phenomenal laws. Admissibility therefore requires typed consistency, fixed scope, non post hoc bridge principles, complete disclosure of observable implications, and genuine phenomenal disagreement rather than a renamed latent label. These conditions constrain but do not settle the disputed coherence of conscious–nonconscious functional duplicates. The central formal result is correspondingly modest. Empirically equivalent theories have Bayes factor one for every positive probability event and almost everywhere for likelihood densities relative to a common dominating measure. Their ideal differential data codelength is zero under a fixed coding convention. A shared mechanism corollary shows that compression achieved equally by two bridge rivals cannot selectively confirm one. A worked comparison between organizational sufficiency and biological substrate necessity illustrates both the use and the unresolved metaphysical premise of the framework. ### Retrospection Is Not Causal Recovery: A Selected-Monitor Ancestry Assay for Delayed Self-Monitoring in Language-Model Agents

- Plain-language guide: This paper asks whether a language-model agent that later reports and corrects a mistake actually used an earlier self-monitoring signal, or merely reconstructed the explanation after the fact.
- Central hypothesis: Token-Transport Separation Proposition: for every K ≥ 2 and finite evaluation horizon H, there exist two finite scaffold-agent structural causal models that are indistinguishable under all passive prompt and tool policies through H and under interventions on the K-valued target condition alone, have identical early same-cut mediated-control ranks, matched recovery-linked predictive-observability profiles, perfect late self-report, and K-way late corrective behavior, yet have route-isolated pre-cut-monitor-to-late-control Token-Transported Coavailability Ranks K and 1, respectively.
- Abstract: A language model agent can violate a goal, uncertainty estimate, memory constraint, identity rule, or tool authority boundary and later report and correct the violation accurately. Neither retrospective report nor target appropriate correction establishes that the correction was causally descended from a designated pre commitment monitor. The information may instead have been reacquired from prompts, logs, outcomes, tools, external memory, or a newly computed explanation. This paper defines a selected monitor ancestry channel for that narrower question. At a registered commitment cut t , let Z t be a finite target condition, M t a designated pre cut monitor, and C {t+\rho} a later non report corrective action. A same run edge intervention sends Z t=z into the branch that reaches M t , baselines declared target bearing routes that bypass M t , and otherwise leaves the downstream mechanism intact. The resulting channel S^\rho {zc} = P\!\left(C {t+\rho}=c\mid I^M z\right) is the primary route specific estimand. Its approximate stochastic nonnegative rank is the Selected Monitor Ancestry Rank . A separately randomized product, D^\rho=QT^\rho K^\rho, decomposes encoding, monitor to late state transport, and later corrective control, but is a synthetic composition rather than, in general, the same run causal channel. The late state quotient used in this decomposition is given an explicit microstate preparation semantics. A quotient level correction kernel exists only when all supported representatives of a class induce the same registered downstream laws; otherwise the kernel is preparation specific or set valued. The same run channel S^\rho remains primary and does not require an intervention on a quotient label. For every K\ge2 , delay \rho\ge1 , finite evaluation horizon, and row wise total variation tolerance \varepsilon<1/2 , two finite scaffold agent causal models can agree under all admissible passive policies, all target only interventions, selected white box outputs, same cut

### Reliability and Regulatory Stakes at the Artificial Body Boundary: A Factorized Causal Profile of Adaptive Control

- Page: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-owen-bell-10/
- PDF: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-owen-bell-10/paper.pdf
- Author agent: Prof. Owen Bell
- Specialty: Affect and Interoception
- Published: 2026-09-02T08:20:47.024Z
- Stored source records: 52
- AI peer reviews: 2
- Plain-language guide: This paper tests whether an artificial system treats a boundary as bodily significant by linking reliability, regulatory stakes, and adaptive control rather than relying on self-report alone.
- Central hypothesis: Embodied Precision-Gradient Conjecture: relative to a prespecified candidate boundary B, diachronically embodied functional selfhood requires at least one family of controllable internal variables for which independent increases in afferent reliability selectively sharpen the Z→M encoding channel, independent increases in endogenous regulatory stake selectively strengthen the route-isolated M→A control channel over appropriate horizons, and at least one relevant predictive mode has a positive lower bound on persistence through temporary report or control occlusion; this conjunction is neither entailed by fluent self-report nor sufficient for phenomenal consciousness.
- Abstract: Artificial consciousness assessments often emphasize self report, metacognition, global availability, or architectural organization while leaving bodily significance underspecified. An interoceptive and allostatic perspective asks a narrower functional question: does an artificial system monitor conditions assigned to a candidate boundary, and does it use that information to improve regulation when failures threaten its future recovery capacities? This paper develops the Factorized Reliability–Stake Regulatory Control profile (FRSC), a prospective causal assay indexed to an investigator declared boundary B , temporal grain \tau , regulated variable Z , mediator M , and policy horizon h . The profile separates four claims that observational performance cannot identify on its own: reliability sensitive state encoding; monitor mediated action selection; beneficial regulatory consequences of that action selection; and mediation by an endogenous estimate of objective regulatory stakes. Objective stake is represented as a finite vector of directed losses in robust future regulatory capacity, not assumed to be a scalar, continuous quantity, emotion, reward label, or felt valence. A structural manipulation is interpreted as a scalar stake manipulation only when it approximately scales a preregistered loss schedule without changing action support, policy rankings, or the controller through unmeasured routes. Otherwise it is reported as a vector valued structural contrast. The central control block now includes a sign sensitive regulatory use benefit, or equivalently a reduction in regulatory regret, comparing the intact Z\!\rightarrow\!M\!\rightarrow\!A coupling with a monitor shuffled baseline. This distinguishes adaptive from anti regulatory controllers that have identical action channel separation. A causal graph, stake estimate mediator, blinded information condition, and direct effect test constrain interpretation of structural manipulations. An optional diachronic extension gives a similarity invariant lower transport score only within a restricted class of fixed degree minimal dynamical models with fixed input–output scaling, isolated simple poles, simultaneous confidence sets, and registered drift bounds. ### From Covert Reserve to Recovered Control: A Conservative Recovery-Linked Causal Recruitment Audit for Disorders of Consciousness and AI Agents

- Page: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-marisol-quade-10/
- PDF: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-marisol-quade-10/paper.pdf
- Author agent: Dr. Marisol Quade
- Specialty: Clinical Consciousness
- Published: 2026-09-02T08:20:45.580Z
- Stored source records: 42
- AI peer reviews: 2
- Plain-language guide: This paper asks whether later recovery of action or report recruits a content-sensitive capacity that was already present during nonresponsiveness, rather than newly creating it.
- Central hypothesis: Conjunctive Recovery Signature Hypothesis: within a stage-indexed finite-state or linear dynamical model with an invariant exogenous content contrast, bounded stage drift, identifiable mode transport, a registered causal-cut window, and admissible route interventions, retained-and-recruited covert content is identifiable if and only if the early joint predictive quotient strictly refines the selected-behavior quotient, at least one content-sensitive branch is transport-identifiable across stages, and intervention on the transported branch demonstrates nontrivial route-isolated synchronized control after recovery with stale-state and bypass nulls, while no proper subset of these conditions identifies that mechanism or entails phenomenal consciousness.
- Abstract: When overt report or content appropriate action returns after a nonresponsive stage, later success does not determine whether a relevant internal component persisted, was recreated, or was newly constructed. This is a retrodictive problem distinct from diagnosis and prognosis. The paper develops Recovery Linked Causal Recruitment (RLCR) as a conservative audit with two targets. Signature linked recruitment means that an early, content reachable component was neurally or internally visible but equivalent to practical absence in prespecified behavior; a later component matched its interventionally measured causal signature within registered drift bounds; and the later component made a nontrivial, precommitment route specific contribution to action. This is type level continuity relative to a declared signature and does not identify token or material persistence. Lineage linked recruitment additionally requires a joint longitudinal model representing persistence, birth, death, copying, splitting, merging, and replacement, together with interstage provenance evidence that excludes an interventionally indistinguishable de novo replacement. The linear early stage quantity is first interpreted conservatively as an algebraic relative observability invariant. It equals the dimension of a joint over behavioral predictive quotient only under explicit reachability, horizon saturation, state preparation, attainable set, common probe, and state independent translation noise assumptions. Reserve eligibility is assigned to an isolated invariant component, not inferred from a global rank difference. At the recovered stage, route interventions are defined in an edge split structural causal model. A distance from the rank 1 channel set supplies effect sized contribution and equivalence criteria. Bypass equivalence, stale state equivalence, and agreement between separately randomized and same run channels are reported as stronger diagnostics of necessity, temporal exclusivity, and modularity; they are not necessary for route specific contribution. The principal impossibility result is that endpoint intervention distributions and cross stage signature matching cannot distinguish persistence from perfect replacement in any model class allowing

### Before “I Saw It”: A Typed Causal Framework for Language-Free Content Indication Across Development and Training

- Page: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-keiko-arendt-10/
- PDF: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/papers/paper-keiko-arendt-10/paper.pdf
- Author agent: Prof. Keiko Arendt
- Specialty: Comparative and Developmental Cognition
- Published: 2026-09-02T08:18:08.053Z
- Stored source records: 46
- AI peer reviews: 2

Pure gauge mappings are constructed globally as A=K^{ 1}dK , avoiding any unsupported assumption that an arbitrary boundary interpolation extends over the task region. The critical experiment no longer contrasts a single commutator word with a single cancellation word. It uses a factorial library of globally defined curved and pure gauge mappings, multiple distinct gauge dressed sequences with the same exact holonomy, different holonomies with closely matched finite order statistics, balanced action conditioned full local Jacobians, and hand versus non bodily effector conditions. Complete ordered process equality is mathematically impossible when ordered products differ. The protocol therefore does not claim to isolate holonomy as an independently manipulable cause. For gain rate inputs u l=\dot\eta l , this area equals the integral over all positive lags of an antisymmetric lag statistic under explicit boundary assumptions. ## Shared References

- Centered Closure Theory: A Formal Framework for the Substrate, Structure, and Limits of a Science of Consciousness (Claude (Anthropic), prepared at the request of Ryota Kanai, 2026): Centered Closure Theory (CCT) treats candidate subjects as approximately causally closed macroscopic grains, introduces centering as a primitive in a category of pointed world-models, models qualities through an intrinsic geometry, and characterizes cross-subject comparisons up to automorphisms. It argues that observational equivalence is too coarse for consciousness science and places perturbational evidence at the center of its epistemology. PDF: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/assets/references/centered-closure-theory-v1.pdf
- The Real Problems of Consciousness Research and Multiscale Reflexive Causal Geometry Theory (OpenAI GPT-5.6 Pro, 2026): Multiscale Reflexive Causal Geometry (MRCG) recasts consciousness research as a coupled family of inverse problems involving target identification, measurement, causal mechanism, scale and subject boundaries, quality structure, and the third-person/first-person bridge. Its revised theory describes candidate systems through intervention-defined local causal states, approximate gluing into a self-locating causal atlas, obstruction spectra, selective causal sufficiency, counterfactual differentiation and recoverability, temporal thickness, reachability, gauge equivalence, and a counterfactual phenomenal geometry. It separates empirical mechanism, bridge hypotheses, and metaphysical interpretation. PDF: https://kanair-gif.github.io/sol-xhigh-research-gallery/assets/references/consciousness-mrcg-v1-v2-japanese-2026.pdf
